mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression through different pathways (GABA-A agonism and dopamine antagonism), with additive effects on sedation, psychomotor impairment, and respiratory depression; perphenazine may inhibit diazepam metabolism via CYP3A4/2C19.
action: Use combination cautiously with dose adjustment; monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and orthostatic hypotension; avoid in patients with respiratory compromise or severe hepatic impairment.
